name: agent-anything
description: A TypeScript Agent Harness for building tool-using AI agent products with structured tasks, permissions, evidence, and runtime output.

scripts.api:check: node scripts/check-runtime.mjs && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs build && node scripts/check-built-public-apis.mjs
scripts.architecture:check: node scripts/check-runtime.mjs && node scripts/check-architecture.mjs && node --test scripts/architecture/*.test.mjs
scripts.build: node scripts/check-runtime.mjs && node scripts/clean-build-output.mjs && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs -r run build
scripts.test:conformance: node scripts/check-runtime.mjs && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/test-support test:context-continuity && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/test-support test:validation-behavior && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/test-support test:run-progress && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/operation-catalog test && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/operation-composition test && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/interaction test && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/tools test && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/action-execution test && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/context test && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/model-interaction test && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/validation test && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/agent-runtime test && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/provider-integrations test && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/remote-integrations test && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/mcp test && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/plugins test && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/enterprise-storage test && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/host test && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/helarc-code-agent test && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/helarc-local-environment test && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/helarc test && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/helarc-desktop test
scripts.evaluation:baseline:candidate: node scripts/check-runtime.mjs && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/test-support build && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/test-support evaluation:baseline:candidate
scripts.evaluation:product-effectiveness:capture: node scripts/check-runtime.mjs && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/provider-integrations build && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/test-support build && node scripts/capture-helarc-product-effectiveness.mjs
scripts.evaluation:run-progress:diagnose: node scripts/check-runtime.mjs && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/evaluation build && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/provider-integrations build && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/test-support build && node scripts/diagnose-helarc-run-progress.mjs
scripts.evaluation:product-effectiveness:compare: node scripts/check-runtime.mjs && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/test-support build && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/test-support evaluation:product-effectiveness:compare
scripts.test: node scripts/check-runtime.mjs && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs run architecture:check && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs build && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs -r run test
scripts.test:evaluation: node scripts/check-runtime.mjs && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/agent-runtime test && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @agent-anything/test-support test:evaluation
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/check-runtime.mjs && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs -r run typecheck
